newsitem.title: USA: Viasoft files with US SEC for stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Viasoft files with US SEC for stock offer.

text.p: Viasoft Inc. filed on Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 2.0 million common shares, including 350,000 that are being offered by current holders.
Of the total, 1.6 million will be offered in the United States and 400,000 will be offered in an international offering outside the United States, the company said.

Proceeds from the sale of its shares will be used to enhance and integrate a newly acquired product line, hire direct sales and research and development employees, take marketing initiatives, for potential acquisitions of businesses, products and technologies, for working capital and other general corporate purposes, the company said.
Underwriters, led by Goldman, Sachs & Co., have an option to acquire an addtional 300,000 shares.
